w:r.w:t: The data dictionary covers the fields, lengths, types, and descriptions of data used in the system. It facilitates the development of the system database and supports readers in comprehending the connections among the information in the database.
Unique identifier for each user (auto-incrementing primary key)
School ID number of the user, must be unique across all accounts
Email address of the user, must be unique
Role assigned to the user: student, educ, psych, accountancy, teacher, admin, or superadmin
Academic program or course the user belongs to, set once and locked after saving
Indicates whether the user's program field has been locked and can no longer be edited without admin intervention
Account status: pending, active, or rejected
Reason provided by the admin when an account application is rejected
Date and time when the user verified their email address
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each pending signup record (auto-incrementing primary key)
Email address submitted during registration, must be unique
School ID number submitted during registration, must be unique
Role selected by the applicant during registration
Unique token sent to the applicant's email for verification, must be unique
Date and time when the applicant clicked the verification link
Date and time the signup record was created
Date and time the signup record was last updated
Unique identifier for each class (auto-incrementing primary key)
Name or title of the class
Optional class code or section identifier, must be unique
Academic year in which the class is offered
Optional brief description of the class
AI-generated narrative summary of overall class quiz performance
AI-generated summary specific to formal assessment results for the class
Per-class AI configuration overrides stored as a JSON object
Foreign key referencing the user who created the class, typically a teacher
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each enrollment record (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the class the student is enrolled in
Foreign key referencing the enrolled student
Date and time when the student was added to the class
Stores per-student AI-generated analysis of assessment performance for this class enrollment
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each module (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the class this module belongs to
Optional description or overview of the module content
Optional text content stored directly in the database for the module
Relative path to the uploaded file stored on the server
Type of file attached to the module, such as pdf or mov
Sequential position of the module within the class, used to enforce the learning order
Indicates whether this module is a quiz or practice assessment
Indicates whether this module is an assignment type
Indicates whether this module is a formal graded assessment
Controls who can see this module: all, selected, or except
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each progress record (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the module being tracked
Foreign key referencing the student whose progress is recorded
Percentage of the module content the student has read or completed, from 0 to 100
Indicates whether the student has fully completed the module
Date and time when the student marked the module as complete
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Foreign key referencing the module with restricted visibility, part of composite primary key
Foreign key referencing the user included or excluded from seeing the module, part of composite primary key
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each quiz question (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the quiz module this question belongs to
The full text of the quiz question presented to the student
Answer choices stored as a JSON object with keys A, B, C, and D
The letter of the correct answer option, such as A, B, C, or D
Point value assigned to this question
Sequential position of the question within the quiz
Difficulty level of the question, such as easy, medium, or hard
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each quiz attempt (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the student who made this attempt
Foreign key referencing the quiz module that was attempted
Number of questions the student answered correctly in this attempt
Total number of questions in the quiz at the time of the attempt
Score expressed as a percentage, computed from score divided by total
Indicates whether the student achieved a passing score on this attempt
Date and time when the attempt was submitted
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each answer record (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the quiz attempt this answer belongs to
Foreign key referencing the question that was answered
The answer option the student selected, such as A, B, C, or D
Indicates whether the selected option matched the correct answer
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each announcement (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the class this announcement was posted to
Foreign key referencing the user who posted the announcement
The full text content of the announcement, maximum 1000 characters
Indicates whether the announcement is pinned to appear at the top of the feed
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each read record (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the announcement that was read
Foreign key referencing the user who read the announcement
Date and time when the user read the announcement
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each chat conversation (auto-incrementing primary key)
Type of chat conversation, defaults to direct for one-on-one messaging
Foreign key referencing the user who initiated the chat conversation
Nullable foreign key referencing a class, used when the chat is scoped to a class context
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each chat membership record (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the chat conversation the user is a member of
Foreign key referencing the user who is a member of the chat
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each message (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the chat conversation this message belongs to
Foreign key referencing the user who sent the message
Full text content of the message
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique identifier for each setting record (auto-incrementing primary key)
Setting name or identifier, must be unique across all global AI settings
Value of the AI setting, which may be a string, number, boolean, or JSON depending on the key
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
Unique session identifier string used as the primary key
Foreign key referencing the authenticated user who owns this session, nullable for guest sessions
IP address of the client that created the session
Browser and device information from the client that created the session
Serialized session data stored by the Laravel session driver
Unix timestamp of the most recent activity in this session
Email address of the user requesting a password reset, serves as the primary key
Hashed reset token sent to the user's email address
Date and time the reset token was generated
Unique identifier for each lecture record (auto-incrementing primary key)
Foreign key referencing the teacher who uploaded the lecture
Optional description of the lecture content
Relative path to the uploaded lecture file on the server
Original file name of the uploaded lecture file
File extension or type of the lecture file
Size of the uploaded file in bytes
MIME type of the uploaded file, such as application/pdf or video/quicktime
Date and time when the lecture file was uploaded
Date and time the record was created
Date and time the record was last updated
